product.name: Travel Size Lotion Stick w/ Honeysuckle Essential Oil
product.description: A little bit goes a long way! Highly moisturizing, our lotion stick sinks deeply into your thirsty skin. For normal to dry, sensitive or problem skin. Made from just a few good, nourishing & all edible ingredients: Shea Butter - moisturizes without clogging pores, rich in vitamins A & E, gentle on sensitive skin, soothes burns, helps fight acne, eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis & wrinkles! Coconut & Palm oils - has antibacterial properties helping heal damaged skin Bee’s wax - offers anti-inflammatory, antibacterial and antiviral benefits Vitamin E oil - treats scars, sunburn, acne & wrinkles Honeysuckle Essential Oil - offer a lovely & simple fragrance as well as healing properties. I really recommend this moisturizer also for older people who have thin, dry, damaged & cracked skin. So soothing and moisturizing for face, hands, & dry feet, and everywhere else! Made in our home in Oregon - you can’t get any better than that!
